plan_name: Simple Task Manager MVP Execution Plan

tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database and create users and tasks tables with indexes and relationships
Initialize Node.js/Express backend with authentication middleware and basic API structure
Build React frontend foundation with routing, state management, and component structure
Implement Task List View screen with filtering, task cards, and FAB button
Develop Create Task API endpoint with validation and Create Task screen UI
Implement Task Completion toggle functionality in backend and frontend with status updates
Build Task Detail screen with edit navigation and completion toggle UI
Create Delete Task API endpoint and Delete Confirmation modal with proper error handling
Implement Edit Task screen and update API endpoint with validation
Build User Profile screen with statistics display and bottom navigation integration
Add responsive design breakpoints and mobile-first optimizations across all screens
Implement accessibility features including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and focus management
Add animations and transitions for screen navigation, modals, and task interactions
Conduct end-to-end testing of all user flows and fix critical bugs

risks: Database connection issues or schema migration failures could delay backend development
State management complexity in React may cause synchronization issues between task list and detail views
Accessibility compliance may require additional time for proper ARIA implementation and screen reader testing
Mobile responsiveness across different device sizes may need iterative refinement beyond initial estimates
User authentication implementation not clearly defined in requirements may cause scope creep
